blocks.text: TradeHQ is a modern web application built with React, TypeScript and a serverless backend. Guest practice records stay in your browser so you can start without signing up. Account cash, positions and server-recorded trades restore across devices when available; earlier guest trade history and journals remain browser-held; signed-in lessons and beginner-journey progress can sync privately when online. The standalone mentor uses a built-in answer library and local topic matching without an AI API request; portfolio mentor tools can use simulated portfolio context.

blocks.text: TradeHQ uses AI-assisted drafting and editing for educational material and software. Checks include worked-example arithmetic, consistency with simulator features and source suitability within the scope recorded on each page. Options and futures lessons are conceptual; the simulator does not execute those contracts.

blocks.text: Community Reviews publish visitor-submitted feedback; we do not independently verify reviewers' identities or experiences. The Community Practice Board publishes optional, server-recorded ranked simulated portfolios, with earlier browser-reported results labelled separately. These are not independently verified investment results. Neither feedback nor practice rankings promise real-world returns. Educational figures use cited sources or clearly labelled hypothetical examples; when a question has no honest answer — which asset will rise, whether a strategy will work for you — the page says so instead of guessing. Content is revised whenever a reader points out an error or a market mechanism changes, and corrections are made in place rather than quietly removed.
